findings.documented: API key is appended as api_key query parameter
findings.actual: Query-only GET /v1/listings returns 401; X-API-Key header is required
findings.how_found: Compared authenticated header request with query-only request
findings.impact: Clients using the documented query parameter fail authentication

findings.documented: Collections use page and limit, maximum 200, with page_size
findings.actual: Collections use offset and limit, return count and has_more, and cap limit 1000 to 50
findings.how_found: Requested page=2 and limit=1000; inspected response envelope

findings.documented: total is exact and sufficient to fetch every record
findings.actual: 3,800 listings, 1,450 rentals, and 440 projects were retrievable versus first-page totals 3,485, 1,330, and 404

findings.how_found: Counted is_live values in the complete listing dataset
findings.impact: Clients must filter inactive records before presenting active inventory

findings.actual: Values are crore-scale decimals; P30394 has price_max=99.9, equivalent to INR 999,000,000
findings.how_found: Inspected project price ranges and compared them with listing INR values
findings.impact: Directly displaying values as rupees is off by a factor of 10,000,000

findings.documented: All timestamps are UTC with Z suffix
findings.actual: Listings include offset-less timestamps while rentals include Z-suffixed timestamps
findings.how_found: Compared posted_at fields across downloaded datasets
Requested both documented and plural paths for DWE-3002501
findings.impact: The documented detail URL cannot be used

findings.documented: Returns up to ten comparable listings
findings.impact: Similar listings must be computed locally

findings.documented: Favourite collection and mutation routes exist
findings.impact: The frontend uses per-user local persistence until a supported route exists
Insights are calculated from the downloaded dataset

findings.actual: POST returns a renewed access token
findings.how_found: Submitted the returned refresh_token after each demo login

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property
findings.actual: 247 exact coordinate groups contain 532 listing records; normalized property grouping yields 3,515 groups from 3,800 records
findings.how_found: Grouped downloaded records by apartment name, locality, latitude, and longitude
findings.impact: Listing count and property count are different metrics

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with current listings
findings.actual: 317 projects disagree with the downloaded listing count for their project_id
findings.how_found: Joined all project records to all downloaded listings
findings.impact: Project listing counts cannot be trusted without recomputation
